description: Upscale a video to a higher resolution with the Magnific Video Upscaler. Input video must be 30 seconds or shorter. COST: billed per output frame — roughly 210 credits for 10s @ 30fps at 720p/1k, 270 at 2k, 360 at 4k. WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll with check_runway_task or use wait_for_runway_task.

creativity.description: How much AI-generated detail to add, 0 (faithful) to 100.

flavor.description: Processing style: vivid (enhanced color/detail) or natural (faithful reproduction).

fps_boost.description: Increase the output frame rate. Affects per-frame billing.

video.description: Video to upscale (max 30s). HTTPS URL, Runway URI, or local file path.

name: upscale_video
